title: Check weather records for data quality issues — check_weather
code: check_weather(   data,   key_cols = c("mint", "maxt", "radn", "rain"),   temp_range = c(-100, 100),   radn_range = c(0, 50),   rain_range = c(0, 500),   stop_on_error = FALSE )

title: Check weather records for data quality issues — check_weather
text: data data.frame tibble containing weather records minimum date column, latitude, longitude, key weather variables (mint, maxt, radn, rain). key_cols character vector column names check missing values extreme values. Default c("mint", "maxt", "radn", "rain"). temp_range numeric vector length 2 specifying acceptable range temperature values (mint, maxt). Default c(-100, 100). radn_range numeric vector length 2 specifying acceptable range radiation values. Default c(0, 50). rain_range numeric vector length 2 specifying acceptable range rainfall values. Default c(0, 500). stop_on_error Logical. TRUE, function stop error issues found. FALSE, return list issues. Default FALSE.

title: Check weather records for data quality issues — check_weather
text: stop_on_error FALSE, returns list following components: is_valid Logical indicating checks passed date_gaps Data frame date gaps found, NULL none missing_values Data frame summarizing missing values, NULL none extreme_values Data frame rows extreme values, NULL none stop_on_error TRUE issues found, function stops error message.

title: Check weather records for data quality issues — check_weather
code: file <- system.file("extdata/ppd_72150.met", package = "tidyweather") records <- read_weather(file) result <- check_weather(records) if (result$is_valid) {   print("Weather data passed all quality checks") } else {   print(result) } #> [1] "Weather data passed all quality checks"
